o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آجو (acu), from Proto-Turkic *āčïg. Cognate with Chuvash йӳҫек (jüś̬ek).
From Proto-Turkic *čök- (“to kneel down; to sink; to sit”). Cognate with Turkish çökmek.
From dib (“bottom”) + -ək. Compare Ottoman Turkish دیبك, Turkish dibek.
From Persian فراری, equivalent to fərar + -i.
Borrowed from Russian натюрмо́рт (natjurmórt), from French nature morte.
